title: Milestones - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Milestones - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The Department of Education earned Asia's Most Trusted Brand Award in Bangkok for being the best college in Asia and launched a study abroad programme with Michigan State University. The University Grants Commission funded a Communication and Extension Cell under the Department Research Scheme, while new postgraduate and master’s programmes in Dietetics, Public Health Nutrition, and Community Resource Management were introduced. Faculty exchange initiatives were established with the University of Tennessee, Sarah Lawrence, and Briarchliff College, and a nursery school was inaugurated by Rajkumari Amrit Kaur. Additional diploma and certificate courses in Domestic Science, Teaching, Needlework, and Home Science were offered, and a one‑year Bachelor in Education programme was added.
key_points: Department of Education received Asia's Most Trusted Brand Award in Bangkok for being the best college in Asia.
A study abroad programme was initiated with Michigan State University, College of Human Ecology, USA.
The University Grants Commission sponsored the establishment of a Communication and Extension Cell under the Department Research Scheme.
A Post‑Graduate Diploma in Dietetics and Public Health Nutrition was introduced.
The Masters programme in Rural Community Extension was restructured into Community Resource Management and Extension.
A nursery school was inaugurated by Rajkumari Amrit Kaur and faculty exchange programmes were instituted with the University of Tennessee, Sarah Lawrence, and Briarchliff College in the U.S.
